test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

What to do in the event of a gas ________.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank requires a noun that fits the context of a possible emergency related to gas.
 
• The word **"leak"** specifically refers to an accidental escape of a liquid or gas, especially from a pipe.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'**What to do in the event of a gas **leak**.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1** "lead"** refers to guiding or directing, and doesn't fit here.
 
• Option 2 **"leek"** is a type of vegetable, not relevant to the context.
 
• Option 3** "leer" **means to look or gaze in an unpleasant or malicious way, and it doesn't fit here.
